name: Sandboxes (E2B, Daytona, Docker)
description: Run code away from your machine: E2B and Daytona cloud sandboxes (create, run commands and code, move files, destroy) and throwaway local Docker containers with no host mounts and no network by default.

allowedImages.title: Allowed Docker images
allowedImages.description: Images docker_run may start, exactly as written (pin tags). Default: python:3.12-slim, node:22-slim, alpine:3.20. Agents cannot change this setting.

allowNetwork.title: Allow container network
allowNetwork.description: Let docker_run give a container network access when it asks for it. Off by default: containers run with --network none.

dockerHost.title: Docker host
dockerHost.description: DOCKER_HOST for the docker CLI, e.g. unix:///Users/you/.docker/run/docker.sock. The pack's docker runs with its own HOME, so set this when docker cannot find its socket.
